stories.title: Suspicious object declared 'nothing untoward' as residents return home
stories.summary: Homes were evacuated in the Prince's Close area of Lurgan after the object was reported shortly after 16:30 GMT on Sunday.

stories.title: Cross through to first Ulster club final since 2015
stories.summary: Crossmaglen are through to their first Ulster club football final since 2015, beating Edendork 1-18 to 0-17 in the weekend's second semi-final at Pairc Esler.

stories.title: Fifa president Infantino pays tribute to Coyle
stories.summary: Fifa president Gianni Infantino has paid tribute to legendary Irish League manager Roy Coyle, who passed away aged 80.

stories.title: Choke collars and doggy daycare - what animal welfare reform means for you
stories.summary: Agriculture Minister Andrew Muir said he wants to have the reforms in place before the next assembly election.

stories.title: Could Paul Mescal's GAA shorts craze be making its way to the Dior catwalk?
stories.summary: A casting call for sportsmen in Dublin has sparked speculation that Northern Irish designer Jonathan Anderson could be bringing an unexpected influence to his first Dior show in Ireland.

stories.title: Former journalist and Lost Lives author David McKittrick dies
stories.summary: David McKittrick was best known for his work during the Troubles, and his book Lost Lives.

stories.title: Further walkout planned by NI doctors on Monday
stories.summary: Consultants and specialist doctors will begin a separate 24-hour strike on Monday morning as part of the same pay dispute.

stories.title: 'I'm 91 but I've defied my age with another hole-in-one'
stories.summary: Maeve McVeigh - the oldest playing member at her golf club - has struck the second ace of her career.

stories.title: 'Mummy's death was preventable, she was robbed of her future'
stories.summary: Lillian Diamond died weeks after she underwent an elective splenectomy surgery at the Mater Hospital.

stories.title: What does the new Brexit deal mean for Northern Ireland?
stories.summary: The agreement is expected to be confirmed when Andy Burnham and Ursula von der Leyen meet in Brussels.

stories.title: What is it like to be Jewish and living in Ireland?
stories.summary: BBC News NI speaks to Jewish people about what it is like to live in the Republic of Ireland.

stories.title: 'Dad was deteriorating': Two-hour ambulance target missed more than 2,000 times
stories.summary: The Release to Rescue initiative was introduced this year to cut ambulance delays and speed up handover times.
